why: a young home's outposts are budgeted on the path their haul walks, not the straight line: on gen 49 the paths run 2-5x the straight range, so a young home took five outposts whose haul the spawn could not cast, their bodies drank the build-out and it sat at RCL2 with its first extensions unbuilt (2 extensions, upgrade 1,070 by t8000) while their dig decayed: on 7a552f3e (the build before the fix) E5S1 let 73% of its dig decay; after it every outpost lets 9-10% (seeds 1-5). An outpost is read once it has dug 10k, past its first container
